verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents outbound webhooks for payment lifecycle, balance and dispute events, with HMAC signatures and configuration through the Dashboard or API. It also has a documented 'Resend webhooks' page for replay and an Amazon EventBridge delivery option. The pack does not evidence automatic delivery retries: the retry doc covers idempotent API requests, not webhook redelivery. Nor does it evidence a browsable delivery/event log; 'Manage webhooks in the Dashboard' is only a page title. Missing for 10: documented automatic webhook retry policy, webhook delivery/event logs, depth on the resend/replay mechanics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
